title: Shootris adaptive audio pack
description: Describes one adaptive soundtrack pack: its musical identity, its loop geometry per BPM, its eight synchronized stems, and the target gain of each stem in each audio state. Consumed by lib/audio/engine.ts at runtime and by scripts/audio/tests offline.

pack.description: Stable pack id, also the public URL segment.

codename.description: Internal name, where the pack has one (zen is codenamed mitty).

key.description: Tonal centre and mode, e.g. 'A minor'.

scales.description: Named pitch-class sets this pack is allowed to use. Keys are scale ids referenced by stems[].scales; values are pitch classes as semitone offsets from C (0-11).

bpm_tiers.description: Every BPM a full stem set exists for, ascending. A fixed-tempo pack has exactly one entry.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the WAV masters and of every loop_samples figure below.

harmony.description: One chord symbol per bar of the loop (length == bars_per_loop). Chord stems are validated against this.

loops.description: Loop geometry per BPM tier, keyed by the BPM as a string.

loop_seconds.description: loop_samples / sample_rate — the authoritative loopEnd for the engine, so the value is exactly sample-aligned.

loop_samples.description: Length of every stem in this set, in samples at sample_rate. Identical across all eight stems.

url_dir.description: Public directory holding this set's encoded stems.

formats.description: Encoded browser formats, in preference order. The engine takes the first one the browser can decode.

mime.description: Passed to HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType for the capability probe.

decode_offset_samples.description: Samples of codec priming a spec-compliant decoder prepends to the loop. Added to loopStart/loopEnd by the engine. 0 for sample-exact codecs.

decoded_length_samples.description: Measured decoded length per BPM tier, keyed by BPM string. Test 9 compares this against loop_samples.

stems.description: Exactly eight stems, in STEM_01..STEM_08 order.

always_active.description: True when the stem has a non-zero target gain in every state, so the engine never lets it fall silent.

audible_in_calm.description: True when the Calm mix needs this stem. The engine loads these first so music starts fast.

url_template.description: Public URL with {bpm} and {ext} placeholders, e.g. /music/zen/{bpm}/STEM_01_BASS.{ext}.

scales.description: Scale ids from scales[] this stem's pitched notes must belong to. A stem with phrase-level scale switching lists several; each phrase must fit one of them entirely. Omitted or empty means the stem is unpitched (drums/noise) or validated against harmony instead.

follows_harmony.description: True when notes are validated against the per-bar chord in harmony[] rather than against scales[].

phrase_rules.description: Melodic constraints enforced by the offline tests.

phrase_gap_beats.description: A rest of at least this many beats separates two phrases.

states.description: Audio state ids, in the state machine's evaluation (priority) order.

mix_matrix.description: Target gain per state per stem: mix_matrix[state][STEM_ID] in 0..1.
